description: This file provides debugging visualization functions for drawing lines, points, bounds, and curves on a canvas, and manages debug frame data within a global window object.

classes.name: DebugElement
classes.description: Type representing a debug drawing element with color, data (line segment or curve), and permanence flag.

methods.name: debugDrawCubicBezier
methods.description: Draws a cubic Bezier curve for debugging purposes, with optional color and permanence.

methods.name: debugDrawLine
methods.description: Draws one or multiple line segments for debugging, with optional color and permanence.

methods.name: debugDrawPoint
methods.description: Draws a point with optional fuzzy randomness, color, and permanence.

methods.name: debugDrawBounds
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes for debugging, with optional color and permanence.

methods.name: debugDrawPoints
methods.description: Draws multiple points relative to a given x, y offset.

methods.name: debugCloseFrame
methods.description: Closes the current debug frame, preparing for the next.
